$comment: Project hooks. (1) PostToolUse: scripts/hooks/hygiene_guard.py is a FAIL-OPEN advisory that runs after Edit/Write/MultiEdit and warns (never blocks) on placeholder content in surfaces, magic-number bursts in source, and broken repo references in docs — the edit-time half of the hygiene contract (the gate's check_* are the other half; /hygiene is the manual sweep). (2) Stop drives the north-star self-prompting loop IN-SESSION, OFF + harmless by default: scripts/hooks/north_star_stop_hook.py exits 0 unless .agent/LOOP_ACTIVE exists. Owner opt-in: `touch .agent/LOOP_ACTIVE` to loop; `touch .agent/STOP_REQUESTED` to stop. Fail-open: any hook error allows the action. Disable either by removing its entry below.
